entities.name: Shokol Wenslauv
entities.description: Skyjek Air Commander of the Tenth Leaguehall on Ravnica.

entities.name: Ludmilla
entities.description: Golgari general who brought Shokol down.

entities.name: Parhelion
entities.description: Skyship that crashed into Prahv after returning from Agyrem.

entities.name: Agrus Kos
entities.description: Ghost who used Shokol's body as a spirit-host and healed her.

entities.name: Augustin IV
entities.description: Guildmaster killed when the Parhelion exploded.

entities.name: Decamillennial
entities.description: Event during which the battle of Centerfort occurred.

events.summary: Shokol is brought to ground in a crash by Golgari general Ludmilla at Centerfort.
events.quote: she was brought to ground in a crash by the Golgari general Ludmilla .

events.summary: Shokol boards the silent Parhelion and witnesses its crash into Prahv, gravely injured.
events.quote: She was gravely injured in the crash

events.summary: Agrus Kos's ghost uses Shokol's body as a spirit-host and heals her with a teardrop.
events.quote: Agrus Kos 's ghost used her body as a spirit-host

events.summary: Kos captures Szadek's ghost and launches it to Augustin IV, killing him when the Parhelion explodes.
events.quote: causing another guildmaster's death when the Parhelion exploded overhead

relations.quote: Shokol Wenslauv was the skyjek Air Commander of the Tenth Leaguehall on Ravnica .
